message:
Correção de bugs e melhoria nos scrips.
Foi incluido também a diferença entre rodar o modelo para a assimilação
e rodar o modelo para as previsões.
com a opção -das as previsões do modelo são geradas dentro do diretório
"DAS", bem como os diretórios exec_${LABELI}, sem esta opção o modelo
roda normalmente.
utilizando a opção -das em conjunto com a opção -f, algumas confições
pré-determinadas são utilizadas durante o processo de previsão do modelo
e os arquivos são gerados nos caminhos típicos do modelo.

Neste commit também foi corrigido o problema para o uso do dado de GSPRO
no gsiparm.nml

o Principal bug corrigido está relacionado à não geração dos arquivos de
Ozonio as 06 e 18 utc, que estavam relacionadas a um bug no scrip runPre

author: joao.gerd
message:
Enhancements to build and environment setup scripts

- config_smg.ksh:
  - Added 'export LC_ALL="en_US.UTF-8"' to ensure consistent locale settings on EGEON cluster.

- etc/smg_setup.sh:
  - Refactored the build process by introducing the 'compile_component' function.
  - Improved modularity by reducing redundant compilation commands.
  - Enhanced error handling to check for missing directories before compilation.
  - Used 'mkdir -p' to ensure build directories exist before execution.
  - Replaced explicit 'make' calls with 'make -j256' for parallel compilation.
  - Changed 'module purge' to 'module -q purge' to suppress unnecessary messages.

author: joao.gerd
message:
SMG core: centralizar setup, paths e help; remover duplicações

config_smg.ksh
- Move o sourcing de etc/smg_setup.sh para o início do main() (uma única vez)
- Remove sourcing duplicado e a chamada direta a use_local_cmake (setup centralizado)
- Melhora o help: usa show_help; adiciona fallback listando funções quando necessário
- Mantém mensagens de instalação (SMG_ROOT)

etc/mach/egeon_paths.conf
- home_smg = ${HOME}/${nome_smg} (em vez de ${RootDir})
- public_gdad = /pesq/share/das/public
- public_gsi  = ${public_gdad}/GSI_NCEP
- Remove caminhos/entradas legadas (public_tmp, plus_crtm antigo)

etc/smg_setup.sh
- Atualiza índice de comandos (configure, compile, copy_ncep_inputs, testcase, help)
- Implementa logging padronizado (_log_msg + helpers) com opção -f
- Consolida _parse_args (-v/-q/-y/-f/--dry-run/--restore e seleção de componentes)
- vars_export: leitura/expansão idempotente de mach/${hpc_name}_paths.conf
- detect_hpc_system revisado e consistente com BAM/EGEON
- _use_local_cmake: checagem de versão mínima (CMAKE_VERSION_MIN), override -c, download/extração robustos
- copy_ncep_inputs: suporta ncep-gfs e pre-year; validações e modo --dry-run
- Rotinas de cópia via rsync com progresso (TTY) e fallback

author: joao.gerd
message:
Infra/SMG: refatoração de setup, helpers e scripts GSI + run_cycle

- Novo SMG/etc/__helpers__.sh com utilitários genéricos (logging, strict mode, path detection).
- smg_setup.sh: refatoração ampla, modularização de cópia de “fixed files” e validações; +2100 linhas adicionadas / -439 removidas.
- runGSI_Functions.sh: grande reorganização de funções (link/copy de backgrounds, fixed e obs; checagens de ambiente; I/O robusto); +1750 / -718.
- runGSI: simplificação de opções, mensagens e delegação às funções reutilizáveis; -265 linhas antigas.
- run_cycle.sh: documentação em inglês (ProTex), padronização de flags, melhor tratamento de erros; +309 / -301.
- config_smg.ksh e mach/egeon_paths.conf: limpeza de variáveis, defaults mais seguros e paths consistentes.

Impacto: base mais estável e reutilizável, com melhor observabilidade, menor acoplamento e setup previsível no Egeon.

author: joao.gerd
message:
Add initialization scripts and refactor run workflow

New files:
- __init__.sh, scripts/__init__.sh, scripts/gsi_scripts/__init__.sh
  • Introduced initialization stubs to organize shell modules and allow
    structured sourcing of helper functions across scripts.

Modified:
- run_cycle.sh
  • Refactored script initialization and sourcing logic.
  • Improved environment handling and error checking.
  • Simplified workflow control for model cycle execution.

- scripts/gsi_scripts/runGSI_Functions.sh
  • Clarified function definitions with improved structure.
  • Enhanced readability and consistency of GSI helper routines.

- scripts/runGSI
  • Integrated functions from runGSI_Functions.sh.
  • Added option to control Bias Correction (BC) cycles externally.
  • Simplified run flow and reduced duplication.

- scripts/run_model.sh
  • Externalized post-processing (runPos) step from run_model.sh to be handled
    by the workflow layer.
  • Improved error handling and logging.

- scripts/run_obsmake.sh
  • Refactored observation pre-processing step for clarity.
  • Enhanced modularization to better integrate with run_cycle.sh.

Overall:
- Introduced a more modular structure for the assimilation workflow.
- Reduced redundancy and improved maintainability of scripts.

author: joao.gerd
message:
Refactor env export, enhance obs_make and GSI sensor copy logging, update fix templates
- Replaced deprecated vars_export with _env_export across helper and setup scripts.
- Added interactive progress bar and structured logging in runGSI_Functions.sh for sensor coefficient copy.
- Improved run_obsmake.sh:
  • Fixed sed usage() to stop at first #EOP block.
  • Enhanced observation copy/link logic with clearer pattern handling and improved verbose/dry-run behavior.
- Updated gsiparm.anl:
  • Standardized parameter syntax (removed unnecessary quotes around identifiers).
  • Reorganized and extended observation dataset templates (HIRS4, MHS, SBUV/2, GOME, OMI, MLS).
- Improves workflow transparency, consistency, and logging clarity across SMG preprocessing steps.

author: joao.gerd
message:
#BOP
!REVISION: 13 Oct 2025
!AUTHOR: J. G. de Mattos
!SUBJECT: Refine BAM_CoordSize() and standardize timestep documentation
!FILES:
M cptec/bam/run/EnvironmentalVariables
M run/scripts/gsi_scripts/runGSI_Functions.sh
M run/scripts/runGSI
!DESCRIPTION:
• Standardized inline timestep comments across all truncations in BAM_CoordSize()
  using the format “# 3600/<Δt>=<n> (aligned / not aligned)” for clarity and auditability
• Updated T254 entry: replaced TimeStep=255 (non-submultiple of 3600) with 225 s
  to maintain correct synchronization of radiation calls at 1h and 3h intervals
• Added detailed ProTex-style header describing Δt selection rationale:
  numerical stability, CFL control, and physics alignment
• Verified that all other Δt values are exact submultiples of 3600 s or empirically stable
• Linked to external documentation (Δt rationale and stability analysis):
  https://gist.github.com/joaogerd/3b95b4c29b29736c197bd3946a2f91fd
#EOP

author: joao.gerd
message:
#BOP
!REVISION: 13 Oct 2025
!AUTHOR: J. G. de Mattos
!SUBJECT: Enhance build verification report and GSI compile block
!FILES:
M etc/smg_setup.sh
!DESCRIPTION:
• Added structured reporting buckets (READY_ROWS, BUILT_ONLY_ROWS, RUNTIME_ONLY_ROWS, MISSING_ROWS)
  for clearer end-of-run summaries.
• Implemented _print_group() function to render colorized, aligned tables for each report category.
• Improved post-copy reclassification logic: items fixed via rsync or cp are dynamically promoted to READY status.
• Enhanced diagnostic messages for directory creation and copy failures.
• Updated GSI compilation section:
  – Fixed path verification to use home_gsi_bin instead of home_gsi_src.
  – Adjusted copy paths to home_gsi_src/gsi/gsi.x.
  – Refined error message to clarify unset path variables (home_gsi || home_gsi_src || home_gsi_bin).
!NOTES:
These changes improve the readability and accuracy of the build validation phase in smg_setup.sh,
providing a comprehensive visual summary and robust error handling for the GSI compile and copy workflow.
#EOP

gsiparm.anl: clarify OBS_INPUT semantics and align dval/dthin/dsfcalc settings

- Add per-section column headers for readability (Conventional, GPS-RO, radiances, etc.).
- Update example obs lines to match adopted dval/dthin/dsfcalc values (AMSUA/ATMS and related sections) and keep legacy lines commented.
